Name: Pi-hahiroth
ModernLocation: Unknown; on the west shore of the Red Sea, Egypt
Description: One of the stations on Israel's wilderness journey, named in the Numbers 33 itinerary. The camp between Migdol and the sea, where Israel was trapped before the waters parted. Nearby landmarks named in the crossing account are Migdol and Baal-zephon. No further detail is recorded beyond the journey account.
BiblicalSignificance: The wilderness stations trace the route God led Israel from Egypt to the Plains of Moab.
